headline.purpose: Restrained sidebar heading; contextual Newsreader sizes also occur in help, drop and empty surfaces.

title.purpose: Compact sans-serif brand with a semibold emphasized word.

body.purpose: Short explanations in panels; help prose uses a slightly larger contextual size.

section.purpose: Compact semibold property and list headings.

shadows.name: paper
shadows.purpose: Separates the white document from the desk.

shadows.name: help-dialog
shadows.purpose: Raises help above its translucent backdrop.

motion.name: fast
motion.purpose: Background and colour transitions on controls.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Reduced-motion media query removes effective transitions and repeats animation only once.

themes.documentRule: PDF paper remains white; document overlays, legends and exported colours do not depend on the interface theme.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: A compact green action for completing a task.
components.css: .ds-primary { font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; border-radius: var(--radius, 6px); padding: 10px 15px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 12px; line-height: 18px; min-height: 38px; white-space: nowrap; transition: background var(--fast, 150ms), box-shadow var(--fast, 150ms);  border: 0; background: var(--green, #276657); color: var(--paper, #ffffff); } .ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--green-dark, #1c4e41); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--green, #276657); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-primary:disabled { opacity: .4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A bounded warm-panel action for opening content.
components.css: .ds-secondary { font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; border-radius: var(--radius, 6px); padding: 10px 15px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 12px; line-height: 18px; min-height: 38px; white-space: nowrap; transition: background var(--fast, 150ms), box-shadow var(--fast, 150ms);  border: 1px solid #d4dacf; background: var(--surface, #fbfaf7); color: var(--ink, #293a32); } .ds-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #efefe9; } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--green, #276657); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-secondary:disabled { opacity: .4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: Quiet utility control with an accessible name.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon" aria-label="Add category" title="Add category"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon { font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 30px; height: 30px; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; color: var(--muted, #5c6962); background: none; transition: background var(--fast, 150ms), color var(--fast, 150ms); } .ds-icon:hover:not(:disabled) { color: var(--ink, #293a32); background: #e9ede6; } .ds-icon:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--green, #276657); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-icon:disabled { opacity: .4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Drawing Mode Toolbar
components.description: The editor mode selector; active mode is distinct from hover.
components.css: .ds-tools { display: flex; gap: 4px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-tool { font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; height: 33px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted, #5c6962); background: none; transition: background var(--fast, 150ms), color var(--fast, 150ms); } .ds-tool:hover:not(:disabled) { color: var(--ink, #293a32); background: #eef0e9; } .ds-tool[aria-pressed="true"] { color: #235d4f; background: var(--green-light, #e6eee7); font-weight: 500; } .ds-tool:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--green, #276657); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-tool:disabled { opacity: .4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Room Name Field
components.description: Compact labelled property field on warm paper.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-room-name">Room name</label><input class="ds-field" id="ds-room-name" value="Meeting room"/>
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 5px; font: 10px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; color: var(--muted, #5c6962); } .ds-field { width: 220px; max-width: 100%; border: 1px solid #d5dbd1; padding: 7px 8px; color: var(--ink, #293a32); background: #fffefa; border-radius: 4px; font: 11px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; caret-color: var(--green, #276657); } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--green, #276657); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Selected Category Row
components.description: Editable content swatch beside a persistent application selection state.
components.css: .ds-category { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; height: 37px; max-width: 250px; border-radius: 5px; padding: 0 7px 0 10px; background: #e9efe7; border: 1px solid #d5e1d2; } .ds-swatch { width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 4px; background: #9677B0; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-category-select { font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; align-self: stretch; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 5px; flex: 1; min-width: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--ink, #293a32); font-size: 12px; text-align: left; } .ds-count { font-size: 10px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--muted, #5c6962); } .ds-category-select:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--green, #276657); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Document Paper
components.description: Square white document surface raised subtly from the desk.
components.css: .ds-desk { padding: 24px; background: var(--canvas, #eaece7); } .ds-paper { width: 220px; max-width: 100%; height: 150px; background: var(--paper, #ffffff); box-shadow: 0 4px 24px #293a3217, 0 1px 4px #293a3210; }

components.name: Legend Switch
components.description: Compact checked-state control for legend visibility.
components.css: .ds-switch { font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; width: 29px; height: 17px; padding: 2px; border: 0; border-radius: 20px; background: #b8c0b6; transition: background var(--fast, 150ms); } .ds-switch[aria-checked="true"] { background: var(--green, #276657); } .ds-switch > span { display: block; width: 13px; height: 13px; background: white; border-radius: 50%; transition: transform 160ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)); } .ds-switch[aria-checked="true"] > span { transform: translateX(12px); } .ds-switch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--green, #276657); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-switch, .ds-switch > span { transition-duration: .01ms; } }

narrative.overview:
Warm paper panels sit against a quiet gray-green work surface. The white document remains visually distinct, while precise green controls make the application feel calm, useful and ready for detailed work. Restrained Newsreader headings add a human signature; compact DM Sans controls carry the operational detail.

This system favours crisp rules, small controlled curves and restrained elevation. Most colour on the plan belongs to the user's editable overlays. Application states retain their own consistent language, independent of the colours chosen for rooms.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, quiet surfaces with crisp control contrast.
Compact, nearby controls with clearly expressed active states.
White document paper with translucent content layered above it.
Editorial serif accents supported by practical sans-serif typography.

rules.name: The Content Colour Rule
rules.body: Room category colours and opacity are editable document content. Do not promote demo category colours into application state tokens or use the user's current category colour for focus, errors or tool selection.

rules.name: The State Contrast Rule
rules.body: Active controls use green text and a pale green surface; selection on the plan adds the fixed `selection-stroke`. White vertex handles and gold `curve-handle` controls distinguish corner editing from curve editing. Destructive actions use `danger` and explicit text or icons.

rules.name: The Quiet Signature Rule
rules.body: Preserve the contrast between occasional Newsreader headings and DM Sans controls. Do not transfer the serif treatment to routine buttons, fields, numeric feedback or lists.

rules.name: The Paper Depth Rule
rules.body: Reserve substantial shadow for document paper and temporary raised surfaces. Persistent application panels remain quiet, bounded surfaces.

dos: Do keep warm application panels, gray-green desk and white document paper visually distinct.
Do preserve fixed green focus and selection cues independently of editable room colours.
Do use Newsreader sparingly and DM Sans for controls and numerical feedback.
Do pair compact controls with accessible names, visible focus and explicit active states.
Do use fine rules for persistent grouping and reserve substantial elevation for paper and temporary surfaces.
Do keep the current editor's composition and demo messaging in surface strategy rather than treating them as global page requirements.
donts: Don't turn category swatches or example overlay colours into application semantic states.
Don't use a decorative shadow on every sidebar section or soften the actual document into a rounded card.
Don't replace explicit drawing, selection or error feedback with colour alone.
Don't introduce new motion or large display typography by extrapolating from the quiet serif accent.
